purpose: Separates related content horizontally or vertically.
useWhen: Related content blocks need a subtle structural boundary.
Inline items need a vertical separator.

avoidWhen.situation: A new semantic section or heading is required.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use document structure rather than a divider alone.

approvedPatterns: Use a horizontal divider between stacked content.
Use a vertical divider inside a container with an explicit height.
Use text only with a horizontal divider.
limitations: Text is ignored for vertical orientation.
Vertical dividers depend on the surrounding layout for usable height.
accessibility: Plain dividers expose React Aria separator semantics.
Decorative lines around divider text are hidden from assistive technology.
responsive: Vertical dividers stretch to their container.
